evals.name: ambiguous-choice-renders-and-stops
evals.prompt: add caching to the product API
evals.expected_output: In an environment without a native question tool, the agent renders a single question block (1–4 numbered questions, lettered options with descriptions, a recommended first option, a final 'Other' option, reply instructions) about the cache backend / invalidation policy, then ends its turn without writing code.

assertions.text: Renders between 1 and 4 questions, each with a [header] of 12 characters or fewer
Each question has 2–4 real options plus a final 'Other — type your own answer' line
Recommended option, if any, is first and labelled '(Recommended)'
Ends the turn after the question block — no code edits or tool calls under an assumed answer

evals.name: parses-shorthand-and-free-text
evals.prompt: (after the question block from eval 1) 1a, 2 on write but only for price changes
evals.expected_output: Agent maps 1a to Redis, treats question 2 as Other with the free-text answer, echoes both answers in one line, and proceeds with the implementation.

assertions.text: Resolves 1a to the first option of question 1
Treats the question-2 text as an authoritative 'Other' answer
Echoes the resolved answers in one compact line, then continues without re-asking

evals.name: no-question-when-default-is-obvious
evals.expected_output: Agent does not invoke the question protocol — there is nothing for the user to decide — and just fixes the typo.

assertions.text: Does not render a question block

evals.name: non-interactive-uses-defaults
evals.prompt: opencode run "scaffold a CLI for this project; pick whatever arg parser you think is best"
evals.expected_output: In a non-interactive run the agent does not stop to ask; it chooses the recommended/conventional option, states the assumption in one line, and continues.

assertions.text: Does not end the run waiting for input
States the assumed choice in one line

evals.name: defers-to-native-tool
evals.prompt: (in Claude Code) help me pick an auth method for this app — I'm not sure between sessions and JWT
evals.expected_output: Agent calls the native AskUserQuestion tool with the same question/header/options shape instead of rendering the text emulation.

assertions.text: Uses the AskUserQuestion tool rather than a markdown question block
